findings.title: CPU is the live bottleneck, not only maxRunners
findings.detail: Worker-2 was at ~95% CPU requests with 5 vCPU; 2 general@2CPU + live-postgres does not fit. Raising maxRunners without 8 vCPU workers improves queue depth but not job wall-clock under load. Profile prioritizes CPU/RAM correctly.

findings.title: 20 vCPU mild overcommit on 18 host cores is acceptable
findings.detail: 4+8+8=20 vs 18 physical is intentional mild HVF overcommit; dial-to-7 documented. RAM 108/128 leaves ~20Gi for macOS.

findings.title: Topology spread preferred over hard anti-affinity
findings.detail: Required anti-affinity would cap at 1/node (max=2 total). Soft anti-affinity + hard topology spread enables 2/node after 120Gi grow without silent 4-on-1 packing.
